summary: The diff implements a comprehensive Matka gambling platform replacing APK-related code. Most requirements are addressed: backend data structures, frontend pages (MarketLobby, BetPlacement, MyBets, Wallet, AdminPanel), Matka theme, Internet Identity auth, and admin panel. However, several specific acceptance criteria have gaps — notably the last result display in Matka format on market cards, grouping of bets by date, transaction history showing deposit/withdrawal statuses, and the backend registerUser function appears to be stubbed out. The diff is truncated, so some pages are referenced but their full implementations are not visible.

missing_requirements.requirement: Last result is displayed in standard Matka format (e.g., 3 45 6) on market cards
missing_requirements.reason: The MarketCard component does not show any last result field. The Market type in backend/main.mo also does not include a lastResult field. No evidence of last result display on market cards.

missing_requirements.requirement: Bets are grouped by date, newest first
missing_requirements.reason: BetHistoryTable.tsx renders bets in a flat table with no date grouping logic visible.

missing_requirements.requirement: Transaction history shows deposit and withdrawal requests with pending/approved/rejected status
missing_requirements.reason: TransactionHistoryTable.tsx does not render a status column. The table only shows type, amount, and date with no status field for deposit/withdrawal requests.

missing_requirements.requirement: User can register and their balance is stored as Nat (paise units) in stable memory
missing_requirements.reason: The registerUser function in backend/main.mo is stubbed with Runtime.trap('User registration is currently not supported.'), meaning user registration does not actually function.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin sees total platform stats: active users, total bets today, total payout today
missing_requirements.reason: PlatformStatsCard shows all-time totals with no 'today' filtering. No date-scoped stat logic is visible in useGetPlatformStats or the backend.

hallucinated_features.description: Legacy USD currency helper functions (formatCentsToUSD, dollarsToCents) kept in currency.ts
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request specifies all monetary values in paise/INR only. These USD-named legacy helpers were not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Separate GameType entity with its own open/closed status independent from Market status
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request describes markets with bet types directly. A separate GameType layer with independent status management was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Per-user totalDeposits and totalWithdrawals aggregate fields in UserProfile
hallucinated_features.reason: These per-user aggregate tracking fields were not specified in the requirements for the UserProfile type.
